name: After § 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text: 3a. Calls on all parties to cooperate in ensuring a peaceful transfer of power, avoiding inflammatory rhetoric and political violence, in order to preserve democratic stability and address the persistent poverty, inequality and insecurity faced by the Honduran people;
